title: dMSA (BadSuccessor) abuse via predecessor link without superseded-account link

searches.name: Windows AD dMSA Object Creation
searches.executed_search:
search index=ev_03_dmsa `wineventlog_security` EventCode=5137 ObjectClass="msDS-DelegatedManagedServiceAccount"
  | stats count min(_time) as firstTime max(_time) as lastTime values(ObjectDN) as dmsa_dn values(SubjectDomainName) as user_domain values(Computer) as dest
    BY SubjectUserName ObjectGUID
  | rename SubjectUserName as user
  | `security_content_ctime(firstTime)`
  | `security_content_ctime(lastTime)`
  | search *

searches.name: Windows AD dMSA Predecessor Link Without Superseded Account Link
searches.executed_search:
search index=ev_03_dmsa `wineventlog_security` EventCode=5136 OperationType IN ("%%14674", "Value Added")
  AttributeLDAPDisplayName IN ("msDS-ManagedAccountPrecededByLink", "msDS-SupersededManagedAccountLink")
  | eval dmsa_dn=lower(if(AttributeLDAPDisplayName="msDS-ManagedAccountPrecededByLink", ObjectDN, AttributeValue)), predecessor_dn=lower(if(AttributeLDAPDisplayName="msDS-ManagedAccountPrecededByLink", AttributeValue, ObjectDN))
  | stats min(_time) as firstTime max(_time) as lastTime values(AttributeLDAPDisplayName) as attributes values(SubjectUserName) as user values(SubjectDomainName) as user_domain values(Computer) as dest
    BY dmsa_dn predecessor_dn
  | where mvcount(attributes)=1 AND attributes="msDS-ManagedAccountPrecededByLink"
  | `security_content_ctime(firstTime)`
  | `security_content_ctime(lastTime)`
  | search *

searches.name: Comparison: any write of msDS-ManagedAccountPrecededByLink (attribute-only logic)
searches.note: Alerting on every predecessor-link write also fires on Microsoft's supported migration (dmsa0909b). Expected 2 here: the attack and the legitimate migration.
searches.executed_search:
search index=ev_03_dmsa `wineventlog_security` EventCode=5136 AttributeLDAPDisplayName="msDS-ManagedAccountPrecededByLink" OperationType IN ("%%14674", "Value Added")
| stats count by ObjectDN AttributeValue SubjectUserName
